 Maui News Flood Watch expires after periods of heavy rain, rockfalls, and road closures in East Maui and ʻĪao
 October 29, 2026, 6:30 PM HST --> Play Listen to this Article 
 2 minutes Loading Audio... Article will play after ad... Playing in :00 A A A 
 East Maui. Maui rain event results in flooding showers. (10.29.26) PC: County of Maui 
 WEATHER UPDATE: The Flash Flood Warning for East Maui and a Flood Watch for Maui County expired Thursday evening, Oct. 29, 2026. Earlier in the day, periods of heavy rainfall caused flash flooding, mudslides, rockfalls, downed trees and road closures in East Maui and flash flooding in parts of ʻĪao Valley in Central Maui. 
 ʻĪao. Maui rain event results in flooding showers. (10.29.26) PC: County of Maui 
 EVACUATION WARNING: Maui Emergency Management Agency in partnership with National Park Service LIFTED the Genasys evacuation warning for the Kīpahulu District of Haleakalā National Park at 5:13 p.m. The Genasys evacuation warning was issued at 10:43 a.m. on Oct. 29 due to flash flooding and other hazards. 
 EVACUATION POINT: MEMA closed the Temporary Evacuation Point at Helene Hall,  174 Keawa Place, Hāna , at 6 p.m. on Thursday. It was opened Wednesday night due to increased rainfall and flooding. Approximately five visitors utilized the site, which provided a safe gathering area.
 ROAD CLOSURES AND CONDITIONS: For updated road closures, visit  www.mauicounty.gov/genasys  and search areas.
 PARK AND FACILITY CLOSURES: County Department of Parks and Recreation weather-related closures include the following parks and facilities. For the most current information, visit the DPR webpage at  www.mauicounty.gov/parks  and scroll down to “Park Closures and Updates.”
 Waiehu Municipal Golf Course (including shop and restaurant)
 All Molokaʻi ball fields (“Duke” Maliu Regional Park, Kaunakakai Ballpark, Kualapuʻu Park and Kilohana Park)
 Kepaniwai Heritage Gardens
 Ichiro “Iron” Maehara Baseball Stadium
 War Memorial Complex fields 1 through 5
 Wells Park fields
 Keōpūolani Park fields 1 through 8
 Pāpōhaku Park
 Kahului School fields 1 through 3
 Maui High School varsity field
 Wailuku Elementary School field
 Central Maui Regional Sports Complex fields
 Wailuku Gym
 War Memorial Complex tennis courts
 Eddie Tam Memorial Park fields 1, 5, 6 and 7
 Lahaina Recreation Center fields 3 through 6
 ‘Āinakea Park
 Nāpili Park fields
 Kanahā Beach Parkʻs Key Hole Access and Kaʻa Point
 Lānaʻi Field House
 SCHOOLS: For Hawaiʻi Department of Education school closures, visit  https://hawaiipublicschools. org/ 
 BACKGROUND: NWS said that deep, tropical moisture will move over the state in a narrow band, packing the potential for moderate to heavy showers in the middle of the week. A statewide Flood Watch for the heavy rainfall event went into effect on Tuesday morning through late Wednesday night, with the potential for rainfall extending into today and Friday. MEMA went into enhanced monitoring on Tuesday morning and into partial activation on Wednesday night. County crews cleared drainage, positioned equipment and prepared personnel ahead of weather impacts.
 INFO: For the latest information, visit NWS in Honolulu at  https://www.weather.gov/hfo/ , follow the County of Maui and MEMA on Facebook and Instagram, and subscribe to Genasys and MEMA alerts at  https://mauicounty.gov/MEMA .
